license.credit: "Montego" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Yallahs.title: Yallahs
ic:Yallahs.description: Dark tones and a wah guitar in a modern-mix classic-sounding reggae piece.

license.credit: "Yallahs" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Airport Lounge.title: Airport Lounge
ic:Airport Lounge.description: Light and airy, this piece is guaranteed not to steal focus.

license.credit: "Airport Lounge" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Hackbeat.title: Hackbeat
ic:Hackbeat.description: Only obliquely Latin, I didn't know how else to classify this one. No melody.

license.credit: "Hackbeat" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Medusa.title: Medusa
ic:Medusa.description: Crazy dark and intense, this piece has a ton of atmosphere, and subtle digital effects. See also: Steel and Seething

license.credit: "Medusa" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
"Motivator" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Steel and Seething.title: Steel and Seething
ic:Steel and Seething.description: Nice build-up and release. See also: Medusa

license.credit: "Steel and Seething" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Virtutes Instrumenti.title: Virtutes Instrumenti
ic:Virtutes Instrumenti.description: Based on 11th century sacred music, this piece can set you way way back in time almost instantly. Several faster and slower sections are available during this piece.

license.credit: "Virtutes Instrumenti" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Virtutes Vocis.title: Virtutes Vocis
ic:Virtutes Vocis.description: Based on 11th century sacred music, this pieces carries melodies only, and no words.

license.credit: "Virtutes Vocis" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Enchanted Journey.title: Enchanted Journey
ic:Enchanted Journey.description: A harp solo in several distinct sections. It works well as a contained piece, but also contains several smaller sections that stand alone.

license.credit: "Enchanted Journey" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Pale Rider.title: Pale Rider
ic:Pale Rider.description: Yes. A solo harp piece with an old western edge. I'm not sure why this hasn't been done before. Probably because you don't imagine a cowboy riding with a harp slung over his horse. It works, though.

license.credit: "Pale Rider" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Funeral March for Brass.title: Funeral March for Brass
ic:Funeral March for Brass.description: A simple new funeral march; atypical in the fleeting moments of triumph.

license.credit: "Funeral March for Brass" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Breakdown.title: Breakdown
ic:Breakdown.description: A rock standard drum kit kicks out a quick and steady beat. The simplicity of the music calls for simple content that is driving and powerful without being overbearing.

license.credit: "Breakdown" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Covert Affair.title: Covert Affair
ic:Covert Affair.description: The scene is set for a surreptitious heist or furtive affair. The fingered acoustic bass sounds woody and dark while playing against the light cymbals and the vibrant electric piano and trumpet. The individual instruments have a slight battle for dominance, but the persistence of the slick styled bass ultimately wins.

license.credit: "Covert Affair" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Faster Does It.title: Faster Does It
ic:Faster Does It.description: Fast-paced and frenetic, the acoustic bass plays in every register available to the instrument, while the drum kit is chaotic and harried. You know... Bebop.

license.credit: "Faster Does It" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Hustle.title: Hustle
ic:Hustle.description: The bass guitar plays a familiar rolling Blues riff, while accompanied by organ, acoustic guitar, and drums. A toe-tapping beat plays throughout, and can be used as the background music for a fast-paced game or scene, or as the intro to a scene full of bustling people.

license.credit: "Hustle" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Isolated.title: Isolated
ic:Isolated.description: Intricate finger styling on a bass guitar creates a thematic melody full of solitude that drastically slows to a lethargic ending. This makes for a great transition piece for an outdoors scene or to depict isolation.

license.credit: "Isolated" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Raw.title: Raw
ic:Raw.description: This low bass guitar piece is dirty ad raw; the strings are forcefully played, and you can hear the vibrations, the squeaks, and the ruggedness, all of which creates a carefree attitude. The drums are barely noticeable. The other bass accompanies the root bass without ever gaining prominence. When the drums stop and the bass plays its final refrain, you can really hear how the music is refreshingly unrefined.

license.credit: "Raw" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Silly Fun.title: Silly Fun
ic:Silly Fun.description: This is a set of 2 happy bubble-gummy themes for a comic platformer-type video game. Also included in the mp3 file are three different endings - quick, longer, and other.

license.credit: "Silly Fun" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Bump in the Night.title: Bump in the Night
ic:Bump in the Night.description: Haunting noises and a tribal drum permeate this eclectic soundscape, and just before the first minute is up demonic breathy noises give way to a chilling silence before the return of the pounding drum. Caution: Very bass heavy.

license.credit: "Bump in the Night" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Vanes.title: Vanes
ic:Vanes.description: A disturbingly sweet melody on an electric piano is accompanied with a slow and steady beat. Synth sounds undulate in the background, fighting for prominence. They ultimately melt away, leaving the piano melody to play one last despair-filled refrain.

license.credit: "Vanes" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Gymnopedie No 1.title: Gymnopedie No. 1
ic:Gymnopedie No 1.description: Elegant and slightly dark, the simplicity of the piano melody is light and touching, with a feeling of pensive restraint. It is beautiful accompaniment to the close of a drama, or of a midday reverie. Composed by Erik Satie.

license.credit: "Gymnopedie No. 1" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Gymnopedie No 2.title: Gymnopedie No. 2
ic:Gymnopedie No 2.description: This piece is dramatic and very dynamic; in the beginning and towards the end the music is soft and tender, but it is punctuated by aggressive changes in volume and minor chords throughout. This piece could work well to depict grief, as the emotions and feelings are similarly mercurial. Composed by Erik Satie.

license.credit: "Gymnopedie No. 2" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Gymnopedie No 3.title: Gymnopedie No. 3
ic:Gymnopedie No 3.description: A slow waltz with a beautiful and haunting melody played mostly in the higher registers. A few notes were added to Satie?s composition to keep things interesting and give the music a more full sound, the music ends with a very dark chord. This music is sad and tragic, and could be used as accompaniment to a slow dance or an art house film. Composed by Erik Satie.

license.credit: "Gymnopedie No. 3" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Darkest Child var A.title: Darkest Child var A
ic:Darkest Child var A.description: A notably quicker version of "Darkest Child".

license.credit: "Darkest Child var A" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Darkest Child.title: Darkest Child
ic:Darkest Child.description: A childlike celeste plays high notes among a barely audible harp and deep bass. In the second minute the disturbing melody is in a lower register, and strings accentuate the discordant sounds before returning to the high register. The music is excellent for a creepy dream sequence or the exposition of an unknown fantasy world. SMARTSOUND

license.credit: "Darkest Child" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Enter the Maze.title: Enter the Maze
ic:Enter the Maze.description: A thumping bass note intermingles with metallic noises to create a feeling of tension and terror. Screeching synth noises enter occasionally, and after a shrill screaming lead, the percussion is sparse but nerve-racking.

license.credit: "Enter the Maze" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Scissors.title: Scissors
ic:Scissors.description: Subtle atmospheric sounds and rain-like cymbal elements blend together, creating an aura of intensity and intrigue, suitable for a mysterious or suspenseful production. The sounds build in force just before the end.

license.credit: "Scissors" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Grim League.title: Grim League
ic:Grim League.description: This all drum ensemble will convey the gravity of the situation; Funeral, speech about a battle plan, the importance of tungsten. Anything with weight.

license.credit: "Grim League" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Movement Proposition.title: Movement Proposition
ic:Movement Proposition.description: Fight scenes and chase scenes. Also good for high energy magic shows.

license.credit: "Movement Proposition" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Relent.title: Relent
ic:Relent.description: Sadness... so much sadness. Plaintiveness maybe? Anyhoo, very down.

license.credit: "Relent" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Scattershot.title: Scattershot
ic:Scattershot.description: Fast tempo and loose timing gives this piece some not-quite-in-control speed.

license.credit: "Scattershot" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Constancy Part One.title: Constancy Part One
ic:Constancy Part One.description: A rapid piece full of alternating strings and bassoons, with long and drastic bass notes. The heavy funereal chimes and foreboding minor key evoke a scene of a frantic chase through the woods or a race against time.

license.credit: "Constancy Part One" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Constancy Part Three.title: Constancy Part Three
ic:Constancy Part Three.description: Beautiful sweeping strings run counter to an energetic wind section with light accents from the glock's piercing bell tones.

license.credit: "Constancy Part Three" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Constancy Part Two.title: Constancy Part Two
ic:Constancy Part Two.description: Full of rhythmic strings and woodwinds in the lower registers, the high pitched violin that edges in and out of tune is unnerving and eerie. The pounding bass drums and church bells ring throughout, a symbol of impending doom. This music draws the line between being beautiful and frighteningly dystopian.

license.credit: "Constancy Part Two" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Sneaky Snitch.title: Sneaky Snitch
ic:Sneaky Snitch.description: An oboe and a snare drum dance a tantalizing number with the whimsical plucks of a string quartet. The staccato nature of the music suggests walking on tiptoes, while the nasal notes of the oboe flits about almost imperceptibly. In the final minute, the string quartet plays a simple rhythm, before the oboe and snare drum crescendo to the finale.

license.credit: "Sneaky Snitch" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:At The Shore.title: At The Shore
ic:At The Shore.description: A mixture of African vocal chants and Caribbean-styled percussion and bass guitar makes you long for your hammock. The piece is relaxing and gets you in the mood for ?Island Time? - where the troubles of the world melt away in the ocean breeze.

license.credit: "At The Shore" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Circus Tent.title: Circus Tent
ic:Circus Tent.description: With a bouncing bass and frantic trumpet blasts, the cymbals crash and instantly take you inside the circus tent, where a tense high-wire act competes with the rotund ringmaster. The music is jovial and intense, with a flair of ridiculousness.

license.credit: "Circus Tent" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Fluffing a Duck.title: Fluffing a Duck
ic:Fluffing a Duck.description: A trombone plays a humorous melody alongside timpanis and a variety of woodwind instruments. This music is suited for a short theme for a comedic piece that relies on visual jokes.  2 Small versions in one file.

license.credit: "Fluffing a Duck" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Private Eye.title: Private Eye
ic:Private Eye.description: Styled in the bluesy swing of a 70?s cop drama TV show, Private Eye incorporates slick rhythms with a prominent bass line and competing bursts of horns. The final thirty seconds builds in volume with the congas until the abrupt finish.

license.credit: "Private Eye" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:The Forest and the Trees.title: The Forest and the Trees
ic:The Forest and the Trees.description: A peaceful exploration of the interplay between woodwinds weaving through a melody, underscored by soft brass chords. The music evokes scenes of nature, acceptance, and quietude.

license.credit: "The Forest and the Trees" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Autumn Day.title: Autumn Day
ic:Autumn Day.description: A reflective piece with piano, guitar, simplified percussion, and subtle strings, this music is calm and comforting, like a good book and a hot cup of tea. The chord progressions are interesting and repeat often, which gives the piece a memorable quality.

license.credit: "Autumn Day" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Itty Bitty 8 Bit.title: Itty Bitty 8 Bit
ic:Itty Bitty 8 Bit.description: Playful and interesting, Itty Bitty 8-Bit immediately introduces you to a pulsating melody flitting above a synthesized bass. The melody changes in the second minute and builds while climbing the chromatic scale, before settling back into the familiar refrain. This could be looped for a classic-styled videogame that is quirky and imaginative.

license.credit: "Itty Bitty 8 Bit" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Aces High.title: Aces High
ic:Aces High.description: Like a night out on the Vegas strip, Aces High makes your hips swagger with a playful bass line and staccato electric guitar. An organ plays the main theme, but when the song changes to a minor key, a clavichord plucks out the central melody, before returning to the slippery organ refrain.

license.credit: "Aces High" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Not As It Seems.title: Not As It Seems
ic:Not As It Seems.description: A quizzical harp and bell introduction transports you to a mysterious land of magic as bouncing horns and pounding bass drums signify peril. In the last twenty seconds an orchestra takes over and the intensity rises, leaving the scene in danger?s hands.

license.credit: "Not As It Seems" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Organic Meditations One.title: Organic Meditations One
ic:Organic Meditations One.description: Very long, very calming piece in D Flat major. Part one of a series of three.

license.credit: "Organic Meditations One" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Organic Meditations Three.title: Organic Meditations Three
ic:Organic Meditations Three.description: Very long, very calming piece in D Flat major. Part two of a series of three.

license.credit: "Organic Meditations Three" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Organic Meditations Two.title: Organic Meditations Two
ic:Organic Meditations Two.description: Very long, very calming piece in D Flat major. Part two of a series of three.

license.credit: "Organic Meditations Two" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Windswept.title: Windswept
ic:Windswept.description: A relaxed guitar and strings piece for the denouement of a story or exposition of the scenic outdoors. The guitar is peaceful as the strings gently build in prominence. The tempo is regular overall, but slows down in key moments to build a sense of tranquility.

license.credit: "Windswept" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Decisions.title: Decisions
ic:Decisions.description: A vocal chorus blends with subtle percussion and panning synth effects that rattles the bones. The choir rises in volume almost imperceptibly before dissolving, leaving a sense of drama and consequence. Perfect for the background music to build suspense and intrigue. Loopable.

license.credit: "Decisions" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Honey Bee.title: Honey Bee
ic:Honey Bee.description: The electric piano alternates between playing the rhythm and creating a sliding melody, while trumpets sound in the background, sometimes stealing the melody. The percussion makes for a toe-tapping good time. This is useful for the closing segment of a TV show, game, or transition. Cleanly loopable.

license.credit: "Honey Bee" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Rising.title: Rising
ic:Rising.description: Heavy on the percussion, this piece is dominated by the rising strings in the second minute, which quickly give way to an ethereal alto chorus. The accompaniment rises together before dissipating. Loopable.

license.credit: "Rising" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:There It Is.title: There It Is
ic:There It Is.description: Very quick and jovial, this brass heavy piece has a guitar riff that sticks in the brain, but ends suddenly. Useful for a quick theme introduction, transition, or for a fast and exciting commercial.

license.credit: "There It Is" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Gone Beyond.title: Gone Beyond
ic:Gone Beyond.description: The child-like music box is the constant in this piece, but the repetition of the melody shifts from innocence to the music of a character detached from life, on the verge of psychoses or paranoia. The choir in the background lends the music a heavenly, albeit sepulchral feel.

license.credit: "Gone Beyond" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Show Your Moves.title: Show Your Moves
ic:Show Your Moves.description: Your toe will start tapping to the bump of the bass drum once the music pans through your speakers.  This song is one for a successful accomplishment or the happy ending to a difficult challenge.  The staccato melody resembles a synthesized tremolo violin, while the bass guitar thumps increase  in prominence until they are your heartbeat.

license.credit: "Show Your Moves" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Sneaky.title: Sneaky
ic:Sneaky.description: Ascending and descending chromatic scales gives this piece an air of mischief; perfectly suited for a cartoon. It has moments of tenuous fluidity, rapid motion, and a touch of suspense, making it perfect for the classic scene where the hero is sneaking past the sleeping giant.

license.credit: "Sneaky" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:At Rest.title: At Rest
ic:At Rest.description: A recurring voice melody cascades over piano chords that sway in the breeze. Strings and horns then play the melody as the piano is slightly more forceful before settling again. It is suggestive of sadness, but with a sense of closure and peace.

license.credit: "At Rest" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Dark Times.title: Dark Times
ic:Dark Times.description: Deeply troubling and somber, this piece is heavy on the bass strings, especially in the last minute. The feel is very dark and funereal, and could be used to depict the beginning of the apocalypse.

license.credit: "Dark Times" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:In The West.title: In The West
ic:In The West.description: The percussion and strings start off bright, but deceive you as they turn to a powerful minor key. The string bass plays a prominent role, interacting with and leading the treble to the sudden conclusion.

license.credit: "In The West" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Procession of the King.title: Procession of the King
ic:Procession of the King.description: A strings only piece, evocative of love, romance, and pride. Just before the one minute mark the music takes an unexpected turn, becoming intensely emotional and beautiful as the strings play in the higher register with a slight tremolo, with the bass filling up the empty space in the last half minute.

license.credit: "Procession of the King" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:The Other Side of the Door.title: The Other Side of the Door
ic:The Other Side of the Door.file: ic/The Other Side of the Door.mp3
ic:The Other Side of the Door.description: A quick and off-color melody on the harp transports you to a mystical eerie world, while a flute plays a sweet melody, and pizzicato strings create a playful undertone. Quite a bit happens in this piece musically, it can be used to complement scenes of mischief, an eerie scene, or a world of magic and intrigue.

license.credit: "The Other Side of the Door" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Cattails.title: Cattails
ic:Cattails.description: An acoustic guitar and a banjo create a drifting lull as an accordion and erhu play a languid melody. The accordion is slightly forceful, while the tremolo of the erhu is uncertain, creating an intertwined dialogue of two vastly different characters. The piece is calm and pensive, with subtle notes of East Asian and Country Western influences.

license.credit: "Cattails" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Pinball Spring 160.title: Pinball Spring 160
ic:Pinball Spring 160.description: Triumphant and exuberant, this arcade groove is bright and perfect for retro games or humorous video content. Super fast J-Pop feel version.

license.credit: "Pinball Spring 160" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Pinball Spring.title: Pinball Spring
ic:Pinball Spring.description: Triumphant and exuberant, this arcade groove is bright and perfect for retro games or humorous video content. It has a thumping beat that is light-hearted, and is easily looped for continuous play.

license.credit: "Pinball Spring" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Tafi Maradi no voice.title: Tafi Maradi no voice
ic:Tafi Maradi no voice.description: Percussion beats and shakers instantly make your feet tap, involving you in the tribal experience of ritual kinship. Three sets of call-and-response chanting slide into the forefront of the beat, interspersed with rapid djembe solos to the ending when the dust finally settles.

license.credit: "Tafi Maradi no voice" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Tafi Maradi.title: Tafi Maradi
ic:Tafi Maradi.description: Percussion beats and shakers instantly make your feet tap, involving you in the tribal experience of ritual kinship. Three sets of call-and-response chanting slide into the forefront of the beat, interspersed with rapid djembe solos to the ending when the dust finally settles.

license.credit: "Tafi Maradi" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Amazing Plan - Distressed.title: Amazing Plan - Distressed
ic:Amazing Plan - Distressed.description: With elements of a quick Russian polka playing in the immigrant section of industrial-era New York City, this piece is mainly in a minor key, but at the halfway point changes to a major key, reversing the feel and tone for a few seconds, before reverting to the darkness of the minor key.

license.credit: "Amazing Plan - Distressed" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Iron Horse - Distressed.title: Iron Horse - Distressed
ic:Iron Horse - Distressed.description: Darkly plodding, this staccato piano piece is the tense setting for the classic silent film scene: the heroine is tied to the train tracks, the steam engine train plugging along towards her. The chug-a-chug feel is maintained by a tense hammering of the chords in triplets, depicting machinery or chaos set in motion without an end in sight.

license.credit: "Iron Horse - Distressed" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Merry Go - Distressed.title: Merry Go - Distressed
ic:Merry Go - Distressed.description: Comedic and playful, this rag-time ditty has a strong melody, and is heavy in the bass chords. The second minute features flighty finger-work, as if an energetic bee is flying up and down the scales. The last thirty seconds is a refrain of the introduction, and the piece ends with an invigorating flourish.

license.credit: "Merry Go - Distressed" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Villainous Treachery - Distressed.title: Villainous Treachery - Distressed
ic:Villainous Treachery - Distressed.description: The melody for this piece is in the bass keys, while the high notes play a headache-splitting constant rhythm. At the one-minute mark the high-pitched notes drop several octaves to play a crunched staccato before returning to the previous theme. The last thirty seconds feature drawn out chords, and the tempo slows dramatically, ending with frustrated trills in both registers, signaling the demise of the villain.

license.credit: "Villainous Treachery - Distressed" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Court of the Queen.title: Court of the Queen
ic:Court of the Queen.description: Slow Waltz. English Waltz. Foxtrot. Slow Fox. Regal in its construction, this waltz is meant for the ballroom floor of a grand soiree. The pizzicato strings provide the rhythm in the first half, while strings and horns play the melody. A harp accompanies a celeste in creating transitions between segments of the music. As the music crescendos into the third minute, the frivolity turns more serious, and the piece ends with a few interchangeable chords between the celeste and the horns.

license.credit: "Court of the Queen" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Failing Defense.title: Failing Defense
ic:Failing Defense.description: This piece begins immediately with horn blasts, strings, and a bone-jangling xylophone. After the brief intro the horns play a melody, then the horns drop away away except tribal drums and staccato string bursts. The music returns in a big way, suggestive of a tense battle, as the instruments compete against each other, until the rapid discordant end.

license.credit: "Failing Defense" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Old Road.title: Old Road
ic:Old Road.description: This music is the introduction to your characters entering a Middle Eastern village for the first time. The tribal drumming is all hustle and bustle, while the melody is winding, forceful, and unfamiliar.

license.credit: "Old Road" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Pop Goes the Weasel.title: Pop Goes the Weasel
ic:Pop Goes the Weasel.description: Heavy bass drums and an string bass set the tone for this dark and menacing tone. The familiar refrain then plays, but is made expressive and almost violent as it is played on several string basses and cellos. The pace is rather quick and forceful, and after the quick ending, a jack-in-the-box plays, normally child-like, but made creepy because of the sinister music that came before.

license.credit: "Pop Goes the Weasel" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Rains Will Fall.title: Rains Will Fall
ic:Rains Will Fall.description: Slow Waltz. English Waltz. Foxtrot. Slow Fox. The piano plays a mournful, waltzing melody, while strings enter gently. Halfway into the second minute, the tone is more hopeful, but then returns to the sadness of the introduction.  Just before the third minute ends the hope returns, but melts again into sadness with the final high note of the piano. This is music for a rainy day, or when the hero to a story has lost his way.

license.credit: "Rains Will Fall" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Rites.title: Rites
ic:Rites.description: Heavy and deep, the chords of this piece resemble Gregorian Chanting with resounding reverb as a harp plucks a few solitary notes. The music evokes an ancient ritual or ceremony, but could also be used for a tragic medieval funeral.

license.credit: "Rites" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Spazzmatica Polka.title: Spazzmatica Polka
ic:Spazzmatica Polka.description: Boisterous and nearly obnoxious, this piece will lodge itself in your brain and make you think you?re trapped in an arcade. The polka rhythm is quick and the melody is spastic. Right into the second minute the rhythm drops out and introduces a crazed, comedic melody that continues throughout until the abrupt end.

license.credit: "Spazzmatica Polka" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Thatched Villagers.title: Thatched Villagers
ic:Thatched Villagers.description: Solid in pace, The Thatched Roof Villagers moves with percussion and a number of flutes and pipes struggling for dominance. The real joy of the piece is halfway through when the tinny dulcimer plays the melody and is then joined by the flutes in melody and harmony. The music is jovial and inviting. Loopable.

license.credit: "Thatched Villagers" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Eastminster.title: Eastminster
ic:Eastminster.description: The constant reverberating sound of rain and the perfect-fifth drone of the strings are calming, but have an air of suspense and tension about them, as if a drama is about to unfold. The koto plays a near continuous refrain, at times forcefully. Evoking pre-colonialist East Asia, the piece is beautiful and stoic in tone, especially as the koto asserts its dominance in the sixth minute and at the end.

license.credit: "Eastminster" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Silver Blue Light.title: Silver Blue Light
ic:Silver Blue Light.description: Sparse in it?s instrumentation, Silver Blue Light is quiet and pensive with atmospheric synthesized chords and guitar.. There isn?t much of a melodic line to this piece until well into the fifth minute. In the third minute the guitar plays a few high notes, and the key changes briefly, which occurs again in the final twenty seconds as well.

license.credit: "Silver Blue Light" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:When The Wind Blows.title: When The Wind Blows
ic:When The Wind Blows.description: Several wind instruments play lilting melodies that are slow and meander through the piece, sometimes bordering on being slightly out of tune. The calm music has an edge of solemnity about it. The ever-present acoustic guitar is methodical and resembles a pulse ? it exists but is forgotten, except when the guitar draws out the length of a note.

license.credit: "When The Wind Blows" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Porch Swing Days - faster.title: Porch Swing Days - faster
ic:Porch Swing Days - faster.description: Acoustic guitars play a constantly flowing feel-good melody, enhanced by an airy chorus that enters early in the piece. The music is bright and evokes a carefree attitude towards life and the troubles of the world.

license.credit: "Porch Swing Days - faster" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Porch Swing Days - slower.title: Porch Swing Days - slower
ic:Porch Swing Days - slower.description: Acoustic guitars play a constantly flowing feel-good melody, enhanced by an airy chorus that enters early in the piece. The music is bright and evokes a carefree attitude towards life and the troubles of the world.

license.credit: "Porch Swing Days - slower" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Redletter.title: Redletter
ic:Redletter.description: High-pitched strings play above a low drone, while fuzzy noises and cymbal rolls flow throughout. The high strings crescendo and quickly cut out as if a knife sliced their throats.  A somber melody plays in the final minute, and the noises crescendo and come at you from every angle, symbolic of an attack and a gruesome finale.

license.credit: "Redletter" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Right Behind You.title: Right Behind You
ic:Right Behind You.description: Breathy noises make the hairs on the back of your neck stand, while screeching strings and high-pitched noises are distracting and spine-tingling.

license.credit: "Right Behind You" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Sweeter Vermouth.title: Sweeter Vermouth
ic:Sweeter Vermouth.description: The jaunty bass line keeps this short piece moving at a solid pace, while the vibraphone and saxophones play the swinging melody, until the bright, thump of an ending. Use this piece as a slick transition between scenes or for the background to a short scene of drinking, gambling, or dancing.

license.credit: "Sweeter Vermouth" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:The Hive.title: The Hive
ic:The Hive.description: Cymbals and synthesizers evoke swarming insects, as whirring and clicking noises abound with heavy reverb.

license.credit: "The Hive" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:The House of Leaves.title: The House of Leaves
ic:The House of Leaves.description: A simple harp refrain plays a child?s melody, but is torn apart by discordant screeching noises, thumps, growls, and mechanical noises.

license.credit: "The House of Leaves" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Whiskey on the Mississippi.title: Whiskey on the Mississippi
ic:Whiskey on the Mississippi.description: With a jumping bass and off-beat syncopation, this is straight from Memphis? Beale Street. The Hammond organ and electric guitar play together as longtime friends, while the melody changes hands from guitar to organ to electric piano.

license.credit: "Whiskey on the Mississippi" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Finding the Balance.title: Finding the Balance
ic:Finding the Balance.description: The beginning is calm with the Middle Eastern dudek playing the melody. As the electronic elements melt into the dudek and the plucked strings, the groove is established.  Just into the third minute the melody changes to beautiful and touching, but returns to the feel of the intro, while a woman?s voice sings a haunting melody in a distant language. This is music of wonder, and is best as exposition music for a film about nature or a group of people struggling to survive.

license.credit: "Finding the Balance" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
"Grammophone Taps" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Ibn Al-Noor.title: Ibn Al-Noor
ic:Ibn Al-Noor.description: Evocative of the Arab world, the music begins stoically; the melody accentuated by simple percussive sounds. Within the first minute, the strings hypnotize with their sinuous melody, the tribal drumming awakening the senses. In the third minute the piece changes to a heavy, dangerous string and tribal drumming that builds until all of the instruments come together in a fitful way, until the abrupt ending.

license.credit: "Ibn Al-Noor" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Clenched Teeth.title: Clenched Teeth
ic:Clenched Teeth.description: Timpanis and strings battle with a snare drum and horns throughout this epic piece, slowly building and rising to chaos. The music is high-action and only includes a few short dramatic interludes.

license.credit: "Clenched Teeth" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:For the Fallen.title: For the Fallen
ic:For the Fallen.description: Beginning with beautiful symphonic chords accentuated by a glockenspiel, For The Fallen builds gently and with emotion. At the mid-point, marching drums build in and the music strikes a more serious tone, retaining its dramatic passion.

license.credit: "For the Fallen" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Split In Synapse.title: Split In Synapse
ic:Split In Synapse.description: A short piece that mixes the symphony with frenzied electronica elements and a dance beat. The horns are blasting and discordant, the synthesizer is manic, the effects disorienting, and the final cresecendo push is loud and forceful.

license.credit: "Split In Synapse" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Fig Leaf Rag - distressed.title: Fig Leaf Rag - distressed
ic:Fig Leaf Rag - distressed.description: The classic ragtime ditty of Scott Joplin, perfect for a silent film of whimsy and humor. The piece begins with a short intro, then plays the bouncy rhythm of with a bright plodding beat. At the end of the third minute, the pace quickens, and leads into a darker refrain, but the jolly melody returns for the finale.  With added record player effects.

license.credit: "Fig Leaf Rag - distressed" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Fig Leaf Rag.title: Fig Leaf Rag
ic:Fig Leaf Rag.description: The classic ragtime ditty of Scott Joplin, perfect for a silent film of whimsy and humor. The piece begins with a short intro, then plays the bouncy rhythm of with a bright plodding beat. At the end of the third minute, the pace quickens, and leads into a darker refrain, but the jolly melody returns for the finale.

license.credit: "Fig Leaf Rag" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:For Originz.title: For Originz
ic:For Originz.description: Heavy strings play several chords before a violin enters with a sliding melody, in tandem with a woman?s voice and flute. The bass drums are barely perceptible, but accentuate the orchestra as the three melodic personalities float amongst the music. The music is full of wonder and power, and ends in a strong chord, evoking a connection with nature.

license.credit: "For Originz" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Mistake the Getaway.title: Mistake the Getaway
ic:Mistake the Getaway.description: The chase begins with horn blasts, and the kit plays a solid beat while the bass strings are a pulsing drone below the horn melody. The piece grows more tense and emotional, the strings taking the lead and rise into a flowing intensity. Danger returns in full force as the music crescendos and return for one final push.

license.credit: "Mistake the Getaway" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Nerves.title: Nerves
ic:Nerves.description: The first two minutes contain many changes and shifts in tone - all intense.  The final minute is a collection of all that came before, ending in a pulse-quickening finale. This is music for an action film, or a scene that begins with tremulous anxiety and ends in a big way.

license.credit: "Nerves" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Orion 300XB.title: Orion 300XB
ic:Orion 300XB.description: Unintelligible alien transmissions punctuate the entirety of this piece, while simple, distracted chords create an atmosphere of unease and wonder -  beauty and discovery. The pace is quick, and the taiko drumming is foreboding and tribal, but the airy beauty of the chords is almost calming.

license.credit: "Orion 300XB" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Open Those Bright Eyes.title: Open Those Bright Eyes
ic:Open Those Bright Eyes.description: This piece is made up of three distinct variations on a melodic theme, and should be taken apart and used for transitions in a light-hearted short video. The first section begins with a bright, leading to the big push of the bombastic brass. The second section, beginning at 0:52, is the same melody, but only features the piano. This section is softer and lasts 20 seconds. The final section begins at 1:17, and ends with an excited flourish.

license.credit: "Open Those Bright Eyes" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Take the Lead.title: Take the Lead
ic:Take the Lead.description: This is a rough and hard-hitting piece, best used as background music to a stressful, strained scene, or tense and suspenseful content. Heavy distorted guitars begin the song, and at 0:41 the soaring synth leads play the melody while the powerful drums kick in.  A high-pitched pulsating synth effect carries the last seventeen seconds to the final punch.

license.credit: "Take the Lead" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Devastation and Revenge.title: Devastation and Revenge
ic:Devastation and Revenge.description: A low hum sets a dark and mysterious mood, but at 0:49 the orchestral strings, horns, and pounding drums begin, perfect as the background to the hero?s dilemma or impending battle scene. At 2:01 the music reaches a climax and builds into discordant, terrifying suspense. The ending, at 2:35, features a lone guitar and mournful vocals, depicting a great sadness and loss.

license.credit: "Devastation and Revenge" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Finding Movement.title: Finding Movement
ic:Finding Movement.description: The koto in this piece follows a steady, plodding beat, while the orchestral strings provide a drone-like background. At 0:33 the strings crescendo to follow the melody of the koto, but at 1:18 the tempo slows and the strings fade away, only to return to highlight the final chord.  With the even rhythm and the sharply accentuated plucks of the koto, this is best used as an introduction to a short film or game, or the resolution to a conflict surrounding family or challenges to tradition.

license.credit: "Finding Movement" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:One-eyed Maestro.title: One-eyed Maestro
ic:One-eyed Maestro.description: This is the kind of music that makes skeletons dance. With its pounding brass, singsong flute melody, and off-kilter syncopation, this piece is whimsical and reminiscent of a carnival. It is quirky, quick, playful, and dangerously creepy, and is perfect for a lively cartoon, circus-themed content, or a magician?s show.

license.credit: "One-eyed Maestro" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Ripples.title: Ripples
ic:Ripples.description: Flowing like water, this serene piece is perfect for relaxation and meditation. The solitary plucks of the Chinese guzheng reverberate slightly, and maintain a steadiness that would work well for introspective, Asian-themed content. This would also work well for anything depicting snow, winter, or Rural Japan.

license.credit: "Ripples" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Stealth Groover.title: Stealth Groover
ic:Stealth Groover.description: The constancy of the bass melts into your consciousness, as the syncopation of the high-pitched piano and electric guitar keep the groove flowing. Subtle synthesizer arrangements change the flow of the song and keep it interesting, while the rhythm section is playful and experimental. This is perfect for a scene where the spy learns a new skill or performs an act of guile, or as the background to a low-key, tech-oriented game.

license.credit: "Stealth Groover" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Prelude in C - BWV 846.title: Prelude in C (BWV 846)
ic:Prelude in C - BWV 846.description: J. S. Bach. This is the famous first piece of the Well Tempered Clavier, Book 1. Performed on piano. Very clean recording.

license.credit: "Prelude in C (BWV 846)" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Song of the Volga Boatmen.title: Song of the Volga Boatmen
ic:Song of the Volga Boatmen.description: Yo, Heave Ho! The classic theme of difficult drudgery. Based on a Russian folk song.

license.credit: "Song of the Volga Boatmen" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ic:Chee Zee Jungle.description: Where is this jungle? I have no idea. Videogameland, I suspect.

ic:Eastern Thought.description: Moderately relaxed, moderately intense, very eastern.

ic:Nu Flute.description: Eastern flute-like reed-like instrument - the Dizi.

ic:Divertissement.title: Divertissement - Pizzicato (from the ballet Sylvia)
ic:Divertissement.description: Delibes. I am astounded that there are so few recordings of this piece on the net... for a few reasons.    1. Everyone knows this piece (but nearly no one knows what it is called).    2. It is very easy to record (Pizzicato strings have been one of the few samples that have sounded "real" for a long time).    3. The composer is long dead and his stuff is in the Public Domain (Léo Delibes; 1891). And for some background... Sylvia is a 3-Act ballet first produced in 1876. I'm pretty certain this particular piece has nothing to do with the plot - or it wouldn't be called a "divertissement".

ic:Long Time Coming.title: Long Time Coming
ic:Long Time Coming.description: Tense and mercurial, ?Long Time Coming? begins with a slow, frenetic crescendo, and at 0:40 builds into the main melody with heavy percussion. At 1:04 the percussion is tacit, and at 1:18 a rippling crescendo builds to long, demented pulls on the string bass. The percussive beat begins again at 2:18, and then the frenzied, reverbed staccato of the piano enters, accompanied by a swelling synth lead. At 3:40 the piece finds it?s stride with pulsating synthesizer effects and a rumbling bass line. Best used as accompaniment for a tense, difficult level of a game or as the final battle with a villain. Because of its steady bass beat and snyth effects, this could also work well to depict a tense and suspenseful race to the finish, or as the music playing during a vibrant, pounding rave.
